mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate directly lowers the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 4.0%, S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in over 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is less than 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days; the effect is multiplicative and not additive.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is absent when either HOUST or RSAFS is declining, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, rising industrial production signals strong manufacturing activity that precedes corporate profit growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: During late-cycle expansions, INDPRO growth does not correlate with positive 60-day S&P 500 returns (Rank IC < 0.02) or the return direction flips to negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in total nonfarm employment directly boosts consumer income and spending, leading to higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.5% triggers a shift to tighter monetary policy expectations, which increases discount rates and causes negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL is above 3.5%, S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in over 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is less than -0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: The real interest rate (FEDFUNDS minus CPIAUCSL) drives equity valuations; a rising real rate (FEDFUNDS increasing faster than CPIAUCSL) causes negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days, and the effect is multiplicative.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is absent when the real rate is rising, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is above -0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansions, accelerating GDP growth signals improving economic conditions that boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: During early-cycle expansions, GDPC1 growth does not correlate with positive 60-day S&P 500 returns (Rank IC < 0.02) or the return direction flips to negative in more than 55% of cases.
